description:
The Lineage Ground Master was created to take a DNA strand or two from our past and thread it into state of the art contemporary designs of the present. Look at this masterpiece, from a glance its difficult to tell from the original 30 years prior. But when you look closely, you will see all modern technology. Hourglass Mid BB, internal headset. Forks are full heat treated and butted same as the Kneesaver bars and 48 spline 19mm cranks. This bike is as high level BMX you are going to buy in todays market.
100% chromoly Lineage Ground Master frame with twin top tube, hour glass Mid BB shell, integrated head tube and Lineage dropouts - 19.5" top tube length
100% heat treated chromoly Lineage fork with CNC 1 piece internal threaded steer tube, integrated bearing race, tapered legs, 15mm offset dropouts and 990 brake mounts with internal brake cable routing
100% heat treated and butted chromoly Lineage Kneesaver bars 8.5" with Fusion Lineage CNC alloy top load stem
Lineage heat treated 3-piece chromoly 48-spline 175mm cranks with Haro Lineage Fusion Disc 28T CNC alloy bolt drive sprocket and sealed Mid BB
25/9 gearing
Fully sealed wheels with Lineage high flange hubs with free coaster rear and double-wall alloy rims
Haro HPF 100 psi tires 20 x 2.0" front and rear
Haro Lineage padded Pivotal stealth seat with alloy Lineage Pivotal post
Haro Fusion pedals
CNC alloy pegs
CNC alloy gyro with Teflon bearing
Haro Team grips
KMC K710SL super light chain
Dia-Compe "Hombre" FS996 brakes with Tech 77 levers front and rear
Haro Lineage alloy twin torque seat post clamp
